description.value: The 94 Mile Motel is a family-run property established in the early 1970s, situated on 15 private acres of Cariboo wilderness bordering crown land about 5 minutes south of 100 Mile House near the Highway 97 and Highway 24 junction. The motel offers 10 renovated suites averaging 340 sq ft, eight of which include full kitchens, plus seasonal RV sites with full water, electricity, and sewer hookups. Trails accessible directly from the property and proximity to some of North America's best sport fishing lakes make this a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cariboo region.
